note: Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/native-vectors.mjs (ua-rs-native T4, spec 2026-11-17-ua-rs-native §12) from src/seed.js and src/substrate.js; never edit by hand. networks: ua-rs's order (NETWORKS then NATIVE_NETWORKS). Bitcoin: m/84'|86'/<coin>'/0'/<change>/<index>, coinType null = 0 (bc), 1 (tb); witnessProgram {version, program}; P2TR publicKey is the compressed internal key P. NEAR m/44'/397'/<index>', address = hex(publicKey). Polkadot: substrate-bip39 from the entropy and the passphrase as given (not NFKD), schnorrkel Ed25519 expansion, address = SS58 prefix 0, ss58 at other prefixes; polkadotPaths: chain codes and keys of junction paths. signatures: secp256k1-ecdsa r ‖ s ‖ v, RFC 6979 with extraEntropy false on every ECDSA row; bip340-taproot 64 bytes under publicKey = x(Q); ed25519 RFC 8032; sr25519 context "substrate", publicKey = the sr25519 key. mode: deterministic (the release call reproduces the bytes), fixed-randomness (test-only: aux is the Taproot aux or the sr25519 r of a test entry point; a release build draws them from the OS RNG and never takes them from a caller, CLI-UAL-02), verify-only (soft keys draw a fresh nonce half: the signature verifies, its bytes are not reproduced). message: hex, or messageRepeat {byte, length}. refusals: each call refused with error Argument, its accepted neighbour beside it.
